fields.Name: Skip ICF - Member Joins by Year
fields.Description: New members per year from MoreCheese: Member Profiles.JoinDate (2013-2026). Ported from "Membership Growth 5 Years".

InputDefinition.userMessage: Show me how many new members joined each year, plus the cumulative total, as a line chart. I'd like to click on any year to see the members who joined that year. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a line chart of members joined per year
Uses JoinDate from MoreCheese: Member Profiles
Shows growth accelerating in recent years (2025 is the peak with about 552 joins; 2013-2021 are well under 100 per year)
Includes a cumulative total series or clearly shows the running total (about 2,109 by 2026)
Response includes a short narrative interpretation of the trend
Clicking a year shows the members who joined that year
Rows in the member table can open the underlying person or member profile record
